title: Mission Majnu
desc: An undercover Indian spy takes on a deadly mission to expose a covert nuclear weapons program in the heart of Pakistan that could destroy the free world.

title: Yuvarathnaa
desc: When the college is now on the verge of closing, a dedicated principal must fight against the privatisation of the education system to save the college.

title: Shaakuntalam
desc: King Dushyanta falls in love with a beautiful woman named Shakuntala and soon marries her. However, problems arise when a sage's curse makes him forget about her.

title: Daringbaaz
desc: A wealthy man's grandson promises to reunite him with his disowned daughter, Sunanda, for his 80th birthday. However, deep family rifts remain after her past marriage to Rajasekhar.

title: Barsaat
desc: Badal, a simple village boy, falls for his classmate Tina. However, Tina's father does not approve of their relationship and conspires to separate them.
